title: Juguetón 2026: Nuevo Laredo Asks Residents to Donate Toys for Children This Christmas
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo is collecting toys for children this Christmas through Juguetón 2026 — donations of new or gently used non-violent toys, no batteries needed, are accepted through Friday, Dec. 4, at the Bienestar Social office or DIF, with a drive-thru drop-off at Parque Viveros on Saturday, Dec. 5.
content:
The government of Nuevo Laredo is asking residents to take part in Juguetón 2026, a toy drive to bring joy to the city’s children this Christmas, Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal announced.

The drive, run through the city’s Social Welfare Department, collects toys for children from the families who need them most, aiming to keep the spirit of Christmas alive in homes across Nuevo Laredo.

Donations will be accepted through Friday, Dec. 4, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., at two drop-off points: the Social Welfare Department office on Maclovio Herrera, between Morelos and Juárez in Colonia Ojo Caliente, and the DIF offices at Aquiles Serdán #2244 in Fraccionamiento Ojo Caliente.

The city asks for toys that are not war toys, new or in good condition, clean and working, and that do not need batteries. Families, businesses and anyone able to help are invited to take part.

As part of the drive, a drive-thru collection will be held Saturday, Dec. 5, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. at the main entrance of Parque Viveros, where people can hand over toys without getting out of their vehicle.

The city said every donation, no matter the size, is a chance to give a child a smile and make sure no girl or boy goes without a gift that lights up their Christmas.

Sources: Eleese Noticias — “Invita Gobierno de Nuevo Laredo a sumarse al juguetón 2026 para llevar alegría a niñas y niños”, Nov. 25, 2026, https://eleese.com.mx/2026/11/25/invita-gobierno-de-nuevo-laredo-a-sumarse-al-jugueton-2026-para-llevar-alegria-a-ninas-y-ninos/; CML Noticias — “Invitan a sumarse al Juguetón 2026 para regalar sonrisas a la niñez de Nuevo Laredo”, Nov. 25, 2026, https://www.cmlnoticias.com/2026/11/25/invitan-a-sumarse-al-jugueton-2026-para-regalar-sonrisas-a-la-ninez-de-nuevo-laredo/; Noreste Digital, Nov. 25, 2026
